anchors.name: ISO 9001:2026
anchors.binding: International standard; certifiable by a certification body
anchors.asks: Keep documented information controlled, so the right version of each document is available where the work happens.
anchors.evidence: An assistant that answers only from your current controlled SOPs and work instructions, citing the page and revision.

anchors.name: IEC 62443: operational technology security
anchors.asks: Security for operational technology: zones and conduits, asset-owner security programmes and supplier requirements. AI that reads operational technology data inherits them.
anchors.evidence: A read-only design that keeps the assistant on your documents, away from plant equipment, with its access listed for your operational technology security lead.

anchors.name: Joint principles for AI in operational technology
anchors.issuer: Cyber security agencies of seven countries
anchors.asks: Understand AI risks in operational technology, assess each use, govern it, and test and evaluate AI models continuously, with oversight and incident response built in.
anchors.evidence: A test set that is re-run after each model or document change, with every failure listed.
